misreadings.quote: The room that was almost emptied so he could move
misreadings.evidence: they had already dragged out the chest of drawers ... and they were now loosening the writing desk which was fixed tight to the floor ... Gregor ... fell onto the middle of the large table
misreadings.explanation: Only the chest of drawers was carried out before the mother fainted and the work stopped. The desk, table and sofa stayed, so the room was never almost emptied.

result.note: The reflection stays close to the text. Only the translation overstates how far the room was cleared before the lodgers' clutter arrived.
